package catalog

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

const maxCatalogRelationOrder = 32767

func normalizeCatalogRelationOrder(parentID string, items []domain.CatalogRelationOrder) (string, []domain.CatalogRelationOrder, error) {
	parentID, err := normalizeCatalogID(parentID)
	if err != nil || len(items) == 0 {
		return "", nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}

	normalized := make([]domain.CatalogRelationOrder, 0, len(items))
	childIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
	orders := make(map[int]struct{}, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		childID, err := normalizeCatalogID(item.ChildID)
		if err != nil || item.Order < 0 || item.Order > maxCatalogRelationOrder {
			return "", nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, ok := childIDs[childID]; ok {
			return "", nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, ok := orders[item.Order]; ok {
			return "", nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		childIDs[childID] = struct{}{}
		orders[item.Order] = struct{}{}
		normalized = append(normalized, domain.CatalogRelationOrder{ChildID: childID, Order: item.Order})
	}
	return parentID, normalized, nil
}

type AddTrackLevelInput struct {
	TrackID string
	LevelID string
	Order   int
}

type AddTrackLevel struct {
	Tracks      repository.TrackRepository
	Levels      repository.CourseLevelRepository
	TrackLevels repository.TrackLevelRepository
	Tx          repository.TransactionManager
}

func (uc AddTrackLevel) Handle(ctx context.Context, in AddTrackLevelInput) error {
	trackID, trackErr := normalizeCatalogID(in.TrackID)
	levelID, levelErr := normalizeCatalogID(in.LevelID)
	if trackErr != nil || levelErr != nil || in.Order < 0 || in.Order > maxCatalogRelationOrder {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	in.TrackID = trackID
	in.LevelID = levelID
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	return run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if _, err := uc.Tracks.Get(ctx, in.TrackID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, err := uc.Levels.Get(ctx, in.LevelID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return uc.TrackLevels.Add(ctx, in.TrackID, in.LevelID, in.Order)
	})
}

type DeleteTrackLevel struct {
	Tracks      repository.TrackRepository
	Levels      repository.CourseLevelRepository
	TrackLevels repository.TrackLevelRepository
	Tx          repository.TransactionManager
}

func (uc DeleteTrackLevel) Handle(ctx context.Context, trackID string, levelID string) error {
	trackID, trackErr := normalizeCatalogID(trackID)
	levelID, levelErr := normalizeCatalogID(levelID)
	if trackErr != nil || levelErr != nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	return run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if _, err := uc.Tracks.Get(ctx, trackID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, err := uc.Levels.Get(ctx, levelID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return uc.TrackLevels.Delete(ctx, trackID, levelID)
	})
}

type AddCourseGroupCourseInput struct {
	GroupID  string
	CourseID string
	Order    int
}

type AddCourseGroupCourse struct {
	Groups             repository.CourseGroupRepository
	Courses            repository.CourseRepository
	CourseGroupCourses repository.CourseGroupCourseRepository
	Tx                 repository.TransactionManager
}

func (uc AddCourseGroupCourse) Handle(ctx context.Context, in AddCourseGroupCourseInput) error {
	groupID, groupErr := normalizeCatalogID(in.GroupID)
	courseID, courseErr := normalizeCatalogID(in.CourseID)
	if groupErr != nil || courseErr != nil || in.Order < 0 || in.Order > maxCatalogRelationOrder {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	in.GroupID = groupID
	in.CourseID = courseID
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	return run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if _, err := uc.Groups.Get(ctx, in.GroupID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, err := uc.Courses.GetByID(ctx, in.CourseID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return uc.CourseGroupCourses.Add(ctx, in.GroupID, in.CourseID, in.Order)
	})
}

type DeleteCourseGroupCourse struct {
	Groups             repository.CourseGroupRepository
	Courses            repository.CourseRepository
	CourseGroupCourses repository.CourseGroupCourseRepository
	Tx                 repository.TransactionManager
}

func (uc DeleteCourseGroupCourse) Handle(ctx context.Context, groupID string, courseID string) error {
	groupID, groupErr := normalizeCatalogID(groupID)
	courseID, courseErr := normalizeCatalogID(courseID)
	if groupErr != nil || courseErr != nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	return run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if _, err := uc.Groups.Get(ctx, groupID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, err := uc.Courses.GetByID(ctx, courseID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return uc.CourseGroupCourses.Delete(ctx, groupID, courseID)
	})
}

// ReplaceTrackLevels atomically replaces the ordered set of levels in a track.
type ReplaceTrackLevels struct {
	Tracks      repository.TrackRepository
	Levels      repository.CourseLevelRepository
	TrackLevels repository.TrackLevelRepository
	Tx          repository.TransactionManager
}

func (uc ReplaceTrackLevels) Handle(ctx context.Context, trackID string, items []domain.CatalogRelationOrder) error {
	trackID, items, err := normalizeCatalogRelationOrder(trackID, items)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return runCatalogRelationTx(ctx, uc.Tx, func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if _, err := uc.Tracks.Get(ctx, trackID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, item := range items {
			if _, err := uc.Levels.Get(ctx, item.ChildID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return uc.TrackLevels.Replace(ctx, trackID, items)
	})
}

// ReplaceLevelCourseGroups atomically replaces the ordered set of groups in a level.
type ReplaceLevelCourseGroups struct {
	Levels            repository.CourseLevelRepository
	Groups            repository.CourseGroupRepository
	LevelCourseGroups repository.LevelCourseGroupRepository
	Tx                repository.TransactionManager
}

func (uc ReplaceLevelCourseGroups) Handle(ctx context.Context, levelID string, items []domain.CatalogRelationOrder) error {
	levelID, items, err := normalizeCatalogRelationOrder(levelID, items)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return runCatalogRelationTx(ctx, uc.Tx, func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if _, err := uc.Levels.Get(ctx, levelID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, item := range items {
			if _, err := uc.Groups.Get(ctx, item.ChildID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return uc.LevelCourseGroups.Replace(ctx, levelID, items)
	})
}

// ReplaceCourseGroupCourses atomically replaces the ordered set of courses in a group.
type ReplaceCourseGroupCourses struct {
	Groups             repository.CourseGroupRepository
	Courses            repository.CourseRepository
	CourseGroupCourses repository.CourseGroupCourseRepository
	Tx                 repository.TransactionManager
}

func (uc ReplaceCourseGroupCourses) Handle(ctx context.Context, groupID string, items []domain.CatalogRelationOrder) error {
	groupID, items, err := normalizeCatalogRelationOrder(groupID, items)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return runCatalogRelationTx(ctx, uc.Tx, func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if _, err := uc.Groups.Get(ctx, groupID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, item := range items {
			if _, err := uc.Courses.GetByID(ctx, item.ChildID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return uc.CourseGroupCourses.Replace(ctx, groupID, items)
	})
}

func runCatalogRelationTx(ctx context.Context, tx repository.TransactionManager, fn func(context.Context) error) error {
	if tx != nil {
		return tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
	}
	return fn(ctx)
}
